description: This file defines various parameter classes and types used in FastAPI for handling request parameters, including query, path, header, cookie, body, form, and file parameters, as well as dependency and security classes.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Class representing a request parameter with various validation and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Subclass of Param for path parameters, which cannot have default values.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Subclass of Param for query parameters.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Subclass of Param for header parameters, with underscore conversion option.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Subclass of Param for cookie parameters.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Class representing request body parameters, supporting media types and embedding.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Subclass of Body for form data with URL-encoded media type.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Subclass of Form for file uploads with multipart/form-data media type.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Class for dependency injection, marked as frozen dataclass.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Subclass of Depends for security dependencies, with scope and scopes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for parameter classes, initializing validation and serialization options.

search-terms: Path, Query, Header, Cookie, Body, Form, File
